description: This source file contains unit tests for the CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification class within the ApplicationCore.Specifications namespace of the eShopWeb project. The tests verify that the specification correctly retrieves orders with related order items for a given buyer ID.

classes.name: CustomerOrdersWithItemsSpecification
